title: Circular Canonical Tag Resolution
scenario: A 3-URL circular canonical loop where Page A points to Page B, Page B points to Page C, and Page C points to Page A, causing Google Search Console to report 'Duplicate without user-selected canonical'.
expected_diagnosis: Circular canonical loop detected (A -> B -> C -> A)

expected_remediation.rule: Every page must declare a self-referential canonical or consolidate unambiguously to the master SKU.
